object_description: compact six-level volume organized around patios
design_condition: Located at the western end of the site, the compact building creates a large esplanade but turns its main entrance away from the principal student flows and remains weakly connected to the adjacent course.

positive.statement: The composition of the first two levels is interesting, with open spaces and a mezzanine bringing together key public functions.

position.rationale: Lower levels are constrained by the dense lower elevation rows and the compact plan.

positive.statement: The staggered alternation of the four patios provides nice spatial variety.

position.rationale: Several internal patio voids are visibly punctuated across the compact rectangular footprint.

positive.statement: The corridors benefit from quality lighting and visual clearances.

position.rationale: Corridors are inferred along the perimeter and patio edges; lighting quality is not directly readable.

positive.statement: The structure is simple and rational.

position.rationale: Regularly repeated points and a compact envelope support a simple rational structural reading.

negative.statement: The main entrance turns its back on the main flows of students coming from the station and city center.

position.rationale: The entrance is not identifiable, but the western facade is the constrained location for the stated orientation.

negative.statement: The staging of the gymnasiums on two gallery levels seems excessive for their primary purpose.

position.rationale: Gymnasium galleries are internal and indistinct; the eastern upper volume provides an approximate anchor.

negative.statement: Independent access to the sports halls lacks quality and has small dimensions.

position.target: independent access to the sports halls
position.rationale: Sports access is not separable in the sample, so it is approximated on the lower eastern facade.

negative.statement: Arranging classes on four levels is not optimal and reaches the limit of the required comfort.

position.rationale: The full-height compact envelope visibly supports multiple levels, while classroom locations remain internal.

negative.statement: The large glazing of the aula and gymnasiums struggles to convince in its use and architectural integration.

position.target: large glazing of the aula and gymnasiums
position.rationale: Glazing is not distinguishable from sampled points; the eastern facade is a directional approximation.

negative.statement: The vast esplanade does not interact sufficiently with the main course, leaving the two spaces juxtaposed.

position.rationale: The open esplanade is outside the sampled building surface, anchored immediately east of the compact volume.
